name: Kaduna
scopeLimits: The WUP point is a settlement locator and does not identify a land parcel. KADGIS has statewide statutory responsibilities including the Kaduna metropolis, but no city-specific parcel layer or anonymous feature endpoint was exposed. Public geometry, exact parcel coverage and runtime usability are unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Kaduna Geographic Information Service (KADGIS) is the official state GIS and land-registration agency, with statutory mapping/cadastral responsibilities; its current portal claims land administration and parcel viewing across 23 LGAs. The live public homepage’s Explore Map control is inert (#) and embeds only a base map; the resources pages describe registered-user data requests. No anonymous parcel layer service or geometry endpoint was exposed, so exact city coverage and parcels remain unverified.
